items.title: 498,038 missing person records were entered in 2025
items.features: As of December 31, 2025, 88,093 missing person records were still active in the FBI's NCIC.

source.name: FBI, 2025 NCIC Missing Person and Unidentified Person Statistics

items.title: 21,487 children under 18 were still missing at the end of 2025
items.features: That is 24% of the 88,093 active missing person records in the FBI's NCIC on December 31, 2025.

source.name: FBI, 2025 NCIC Missing Person and Unidentified Person Statistics

items.title: 94.9% of 2025 entries with a known circumstance were runaways
items.features: Of the 239,622 missing person records entered in 2025 that noted a circumstance, 227,353 were coded as Runaway.

source.name: FBI, 2025 NCIC Missing Person and Unidentified Person Statistics
